text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Goal after goal, foreverrr. ♪ Winning<n>the
souuul! ♪

text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикет
text_block_list.text: WOOOW! That was so incredible! Sob! Itwas the greatest thing eveerrrr!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No—I'm doing my best to prepare for<n>the concert,
but my singing is by no<n>means up to par....

text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикет
text_block_list.text: That's not true! Singing's all about heart!The two of you are both amazing!

text_block_list.name: Нарита Тайшин
text_block_list.text:
I'm nothing special... You're the one with<n>the huge
voice.

text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикет
text_block_list.text:
You really think so, Taishin?! Ehehehe!<n>Maybe
you're right!

text_block_list.name: Нарита Тайшин
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, that wasn't a compliment! I was<n>just stating
a fact...

text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикет
text_block_list.text:
I was happy to hear it anyway! Hehehe.<n>But you
really are good at this—you've<n>got a great sense
of rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикет
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I've got an idea! Why don't we<n>compete in
score mode? Let's each sing<n>our best song! We're
all rivals in singing<n>too, after all!

text_block_list.name: Нарита Тайшин
text_block_list.text: We all got the same score!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, sounds like they're calling to say<n>our time's
almost up. I'll get it.

text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикет
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey! Why don't we finish up<n>by singing
one last song together?! All<n>right, I'm loading up
the track!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh, in a way, this result feels kind of...<n>right, for
the three of us.
